relationship_to_orderflow_lane: Separate development lane. It cannot repair, replace, or promote the blocked cross_market_futures_v1 order-flow hypotheses.

data.contract_selection_rule: Inherited unchanged from cmf_massive_primary_v1: nearest active single contract with at least 14 days to maturity on 2026-09-17.
data.entry: next available 1-minute bar open strictly after signal bar
data.exit: open of the bar 5 minutes after entry; missing bars invalidate that observation

hypotheses.name: standardized_5m_impulse_continuation
hypotheses.rule: At completed minute t, compute log return from close[t-5] to close[t]. Compute trailing 30 one-minute log-return RMS using data ending at t. Signal in the 5m return direction when abs(return_5m) >= 1.5 * rms_1m * sqrt(5).

hypotheses.name: prior_20m_range_breakout_continuation
hypotheses.rule: At completed minute t, go long when close[t] > max(high[t-20:t-1]); go short when close[t] < min(low[t-20:t-1]). Current bar is excluded from the breakout range.

hypotheses.name: bollinger_20_2_extreme_reversion
hypotheses.rule: At completed minute t, compute rolling 20-close mean and population standard deviation including t. When z >= +2 signal short; when z <= -2 signal long.

economics.commissions: Not included in v1 bars; therefore no result can be promoted directly from this lane.
